about.title: About AverianLabs
about.description: Founded by researchers who got tired of opaque certificates of analysis. Every batch ships with a third-party-verified COA — HPLC chromatograms, mass-spec traces, and endotoxin panels — so your replicates begin with data you can audit, not promises.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with the AverianLabs lab team — Helsinki HQ, research support, and B2B partner enquiries.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quick answers about research-use-only licenses, shipping, COAs, payment, B2B pricing, and supported countries.

labTests.title: Lab testing — HPLC, endotoxin, mass spec
labTests.description: Every batch is profiled by HPLC-UV for purity (≥98%), sequence-verified by mass spectrometry, screened with LAL for endotoxin (<5 EU/mg), and audited at ISO 17025-accredited third-party labs. Every chromatogram, trace, and panel is archived for the lifetime of your study.

coa.title: Certificates of Analysis
coa.description: Public registry of every product's latest batch — HPLC chromatogram, mass-spec trace, endotoxin panel, lab of record, and batch-level PASS sign-off. Freely downloadable and peer-reviewable.

compare.title: Compare peptides
compare.description: Side-by-side comparison of purity, vial size, sequence, molecular weight, endotoxin level, and storage conditions across the AverianLabs catalog.

calculator.title: Reconstitution calculator
calculator.description: Calculate draw volumes, working concentrations, and remaining doses for any peptide vial size — accurate to the microlitre.

quality.title: Quality assurance
quality.description: EU-GMP vendor audits, ISO 17025-accredited independent testing, lyophilised cold-chain logistics, and 24h EU dispatch — the quality program end-to-end, documented per batch.

partner.title: Partner program
partner.description: Institutional pricing up to 35% off, NET-14 invoicing, dedicated account manager, white-label options for B2B partners.

rewards.title: AverianLabs Rewards
rewards.description: Earn points on every order, unlock tiered membership (Apex, Crystal, Aurora), and refer a colleague — €15 off for each of you.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.description: Your saved research peptides — track stock and batch releases for the products you want, so new lots never slip past.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping & returns
shippingReturns.description: Carriers (Posti, DHL, DPD), 24h dispatch, cold-chain handling, regional rates, and returns policy.

legalCookies.title: Cookie policy
legalCookies.description: Essential vs analytics cookies (PostHog, Plausible). How to withdraw consent at any time.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy policy
legalPrivacy.description: GDPR-compliant privacy policy: data collected, lawful basis, subprocessors, retention, your rights, DPO contact.

research.disclaimer: For research use only. Not for human or animal use.
research.disclaimerFull: All products sold by AverianLabs are intended solely for laboratory research and in-vitro studies. They are not intended for human consumption, diagnostic use, or therapeutic applications. By purchasing, you confirm you are a qualified researcher or institutional buyer.

home.heroSubtitle: Every batch third-party HPLC + mass spec + endotoxin verified. Lyophilised for cold-chain integrity. 24h EU dispatch. For researchers who don't compromise on data.
home.featuredSub: Every vial ships with a batch-specific COA — HPLC chromatogram, mass-spec trace, endotoxin panel, and lab-of-record sign-off — ready for your records.

home.catWeightDesc: GLP-1 and GIP receptor signalling in vitro. Receptor assays, cell culture, ADME profiling.
home.catRecoveryDesc: Angiogenic and tissue-remodelling research. Cell migration models, fibroblast activity, wound-model assays.
home.catCognitiveDesc: Neurotrophin and neuronal cell culture research. BDNF signalling, in vitro neurobiology.
home.catLongevityDesc: Telomere biology and NAD⁺-pathway research. Senescence models, mitochondrial function.
home.catCosmeticDesc: Melanogenesis and skin-tissue models. Keratinocyte culture, melanocyte signalling.
home.labSub: Every vial ships with a public certificate of analysis. Click any batch ID to inspect HPLC chromatograms, mass-spec traces, endotoxin panels, and the lab of record — data your reviewers can verify, not just trust.
home.calcSub: Built by researchers, for researchers. Compute draw volumes, working concentrations, and remaining doses for any vial size — accurate to the microlitre.
home.partnerSub: Volume pricing, NET-14 invoicing, a dedicated account manager. Built for CROs and core labs running high-throughput screens and longitudinal studies. Apply once — hear back in 48h.
home.newsletterSub: New SKUs, peer-reviewed literature digests, and lab notes from our research team. One email a month. No spam — unsubscribe in one click.
